result.answer: ERC-9003 requires calls to verify the delegated signer before execution; the negative test rejects an invalid delegated signer [spec:9003:v1 — https://eips.example/EIPS/eip-9003; test:9003:t1 — https://github.example/org/repo/blob/a1/test_9003.py].
result.normative_conclusion: Delegated-signer verification is mandatory before execution [spec:9003:v1 — https://eips.example/EIPS/eip-9003].
